outcome_evidence: The robot approaches and aligns with the upper drawer handle (frames 0–59, left_ego_image and wrist_image), then pulls the drawer outward, visibly exposing its sides and the opening in the cabinet (frames 90–109, image and left_ego_image). The gripper releases and withdraws while the drawer remains open through frame 151 (frames 110–151, image, left_ego_image and wrist_image). No failed acquisition or unintended side effect is visibly established.
